searchText: <@393119312350543872> hi! Is there any way to figure out why this state root https://github.com/ethereum/legacytests/blob/master/Cancun/GeneralStateTests/stExample/eip1559.json#L91 is different from https://github.com/ethereum/legacytests/blob/master/Cancun/GeneralStateTests/stExample/eip1559.json#L104 Check the blockchain version of the test it comes with full state printed. If identical, can ask go evm or evmone to trace execution. Eip 158 might be to account touch? This test is to check how 1559 tx gets rejected. But the test is generated using transition tool which might handle the state weird. The roots are for blocks without txs. The tx is rejected in both cases Just something weird with pre-states or so (which are not falling under EIP-158 cut, cos having nonces=0x1 and balances) Is coinbase acount in pre state? If its empty it still calculated as touched in empty blocks Oh it's different in Blockchain tests https://github.com/ethereum/legacytests/blob/master/Cancun/BlockchainTests/GeneralStateTests/stExample/eip1559.json#L753 No, not there Oh man thank you a lot! Passes now Ok. Thats a common issue. Shall mark it that t8n calculates an empty block if transaction is rejected and stores its post hash. And bc version of the test has invalid block (since tx is rejected) and state remains pre state.
